title: WFX models result object v1
description: The single JSON object emitted on stdout by 'wfx models --json'. Only profiles carrying a model key appear. Profiles that fail to resolve carry null endpoint fields; the reason is written to stderr as a warning.

protocol.description: Null when the profile fails to resolve.

base_url.description: Null when the profile fails to resolve.

has_credentials.description: True when the profile resolves with an api_key or a non-empty header value; the credential value is never emitted.
